draft.title: Pay and conditions
card: National Employment Standards
ten minimum entitlements that apply to almost all employees in Australia, such as annual leave, personal leave and maximum weekly hours.
Award
a set of minimum pay rates and conditions for a particular industry or job, such as penalty rates and breaks. It sits on top of the National Employment Standards.
Enterprise agreement
a deal bargained between an employer and its employees at one workplace. It can add to the minimums, but it cannot drop below them.
Employers must meet these minimums, so a worker's pay and conditions come from the standards, any award that covers them and any agreement at their workplace.
draft.remember: Standards and awards set the minimum. An enterprise agreement can add more at one workplace.

a.q: Which of these is an enterprise agreement?
opts: A deal bargained between one employer and its staff
A list of minimum entitlements for almost all employees
Minimum pay rates for every worker in one industry
A rule that sets the same pay for all workplaces
a.why: An enterprise agreement is bargained at a single workplace between an employer and its employees. Minimum entitlements for almost all employees are the National Employment Standards, and industry minimums are an award.
a.clue: Think about where the deal is made and who makes it.

b.q: Priya's award sets a minimum hourly rate for café workers. Her café owner and staff bargain a deal with a higher rate and extra leave. What does this deal show?
opts: An enterprise agreement can add to the minimums
An enterprise agreement can replace the minimum standards
An award can only be set by one workplace
The National Employment Standards set the hourly rate
b.why: A deal bargained at one workplace is an enterprise agreement, and it can add more than the minimums. It cannot drop below them, so it does not replace the standards. The hourly rate here comes from the award and the deal, not the standards.
b.clue: A workplace deal builds on the minimums rather than removing them.

a.best: A deal bargained between one employer and its staff

b.best: An enterprise agreement can add to the minimums

problems.detail: The National Employment Standards are now 11 minimum entitlements, not ten. Family and domestic violence leave was added as a separate entitlement from late 2022, and the Fair Work Ombudsman describes 11 NES. 'Ten' is out of date.

The clue ('A workplace deal builds on the minimums rather than removing them') nearly restates the right option and rules out the 'replace' distractor, so a student can answer without knowing the idea.
